verdict.rationale: Bland is a hosted voice AI platform, so self-hosting is a fair question for it, but nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-prem deployment. The enterprise docs describe dedicated, isolated infrastructure with version pinning and canary releases, but that infrastructure is run by Bland, not by the customer. A community user looking for an open-source alternative they could "run on my own" also implies Bland cannot be self-hosted.
